assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original panda character art-direction exploration board for an adult-friendly exercise companion app. This is an ART DESIGN STUDY, not a software interface, not a rig diagram, not a production asset.
Create a polished landscape character-design sheet with THREE CLEARLY DIFFERENT ORIGINAL panda directions in three equal columns. Warm off-white paper background, generous whitespace, subtle thin dividers, confident professional animation character art. Each column contains a large full-body relaxed standing pose with natural weight shift, a second smaller full-body happy stepping or greeting pose with clear line of action and asymmetry, and three tiny expressive head studies. Keep each character's identity and proportions consistent within its own column. All are black/cream giant pandas with simple expressive features, curved continuous limbs, a matte painted animation maquette feel with restrained 2-3 tone shading. No fur simulation, gloss, sculpted seams, visible mechanical ball joints, realistic human anatomy or bodybuilder proportions. They should feel designed by a thoughtful character artist, not generic baby clip art. No familiar existing franchise characters, no logos or copied costumes.
Column A text: "A 松弛陪伴"
Character A: a calm understated everyday friend, around 2.2 heads tall, wide softened trapezoid head with heavier lower cheeks, small quiet oval eyes inside gently drooping bean-shaped eye patches, tiny offset half-smile, small round ears, low pear-shaped torso, supple short forearms with simple mitten paws. Feet visibly support the weight. In the standing pose one shoulder slightly lower and one paw resting naturally beside the belly; in the second pose soft one-handed greeting with torso leaning and opposite planted foot. Minimal muted sage ankle wrap as the only small accessory. Appealing dry humor, calm approachable adult companion, not sleepy sick or sad.
Column B text: "B 轻巧搭子"
Character B: warm playful exercise buddy, around 2.6 heads tall, rounded-square head narrower than A, slight muzzle/chin mass, a single small rounded forehead tuft, distinct softly angled oval black eye patches, bright but small readable eyes with subtle eyelids, small assured smile. Rounded bean torso with a visible waist transition, gently curved black arms long enough for elbows to read, broad rounded paws, short flexible legs and small outward-turned feet. One simple muted terracotta wrist wrap with two cream stripes; no clothes or sports equipment. Main pose has a soft contrapposto and relaxed curved elbows, second pose is an energetic small step with the leading foot planted, shoulder/hip counter-tilt, friendly head turn, curved motion flow through the body. Cute capable peer, not muscular, not a child mascot.
Column C text: "C 圆团呆萌"
Character C: compact squishy mischievous companion, around 1.8 heads tall, compact merged pear silhouette with modest rounded head rather than giant floating baby head, wide-set small eyes, compact circular black eye patches, tiny triangular nose and playful understated mouth, small unevenly tilted ears, short rounded limbs that remain distinct from the body. Minimal dull sky-blue scarflet with extremely short end as the only accessory. Main pose curious side lean, second pose an excited gentle tiptoe greeting with one foot planted and a little body squash. Not a literal ball or a stiff plush toy.
Title at top in clean dark Chinese typography: "熊猫 IP · 三种性格方向"
Small subtitle: "先比较造型、表情和姿势，再决定三维与像素呈现"
Footer: "原创概念探索 · 尚未定稿"
Do not include technical labels, skeleton lines, gym furniture, weights, additional characters, background scenery, decorative sparkles, pink blush discs, large glass eyes or big open baby mouths. Maintain clear black-and-cream value design and readable elbow/torso negative spaces. Focus on appealing shapes and living poses.
assets.notes: Three alternate silhouettes and personalities. Not a rig, 3D model, animation sample, or approved final proportions.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL panda IP visual-development model and pose sheet, draft for a workout companion. Use the supplied picture ONLY as a reference for the clarity of CARTOON GESTURES and compact short-paw anatomy. DO NOT copy its exact panda face, red nose, orange hat, staff, clothing, palette, watermarks or individual poses.
Create one original panda named only by the direction label "D 短爪灵动". This is a NEW DESIGN OPTION for comparison, not a finalized model. Wide landscape board on clean warm ivory, professional hand-drawn animation model-sheet quality. Controlled dark warm-charcoal outline, flat cream and charcoal fills with only one restrained shadow tone. NO realistic fur, watercolor texture, plush fabric, 3D rendering or glossy eyes. Bold appealing silhouette suitable for future small pixel translation, but DRAW CLEAN NON-PIXEL master art here.
CHARACTER: a compact pear/bean-shaped giant panda, around 2.0 heads tall excluding ears, subtly rounded-square head with full lower cheeks, gentle small projecting cream muzzle, small matte charcoal nose, leaf/bean eye patches gently tilted toward the nose, readable modest eyes with flexible eyelids and expressive but simple brows. One small bent cream forelock, two small round ears. Mildly cheeky assured half-smile, playful and adult-friendly, NOT angry or aggressive, NOT huge baby eyes. No visible human shoulders, neck, upper-body muscle, long human legs or joint seams. Short supple black forepaws with expressive rounded mitten silhouettes, hind paws close to lower body. Small cream rump tail. A single narrow muted jade wrist tie as optional identifying accent, fixed to the panda's own LEFT wrist in every view; keep it understated. Hands and feet remain clearly visible. The body is soft and responsive, not a rigid oval with rotating limbs.
LAYOUT:
Top title exact: "D 短爪灵动"
Subtitle exact: "圆润短爪 · 有点机灵 · 动作带着全身走"
TOP ROW: FOUR equally scaled views of THE SAME CHARACTER, aligned feet baseline, relaxed asymmetric neutral posture, consistent head size, markings, paw length and body mass: front, three-quarter, side, back. Labels exact: "正面" "斜侧" "侧面" "背面". Side view must reveal modest muzzle and a continuous soft back-to-rump curve, not a panda face pasted onto an egg.
BOTTOM ROW: FOUR dynamic pose studies of that IDENTICAL character, substantially different torso silhouettes and weight placement, no props:
1 greeting: planted supporting foot, slight torso lean, one paw raised away from the belly, curious head tilt; label "招呼".
2 confident ready: slightly lowered compact body with one paw near chest and other low, feet grounded, playful narrow-eyed grin, no combat imagery; label "准备".
3 buoyant tiny side-step: curved line of action, torso gently stretched diagonally, one foot planted and one lifted, hips and head reacting naturally, no floating disconnected limbs; label "小步".
4 sitting down to rest: torso visibly compressed into a low pear, paws relaxed on belly, short feet forward, relieved eyes and tiny satisfied smile; label "休息".
Every pose must be designed as a whole-body acting pose, with coherent shoulders/hips/head/feet, not identical torso stamps with limb rotations. Preserve volume while shape changes. Add a tiny solid-charcoal silhouette thumbnail below each bottom pose to show it remains readable with no face details.
Footer exact: "原创设计草案 · 比例与动态仍需确认"
No extra text, no busy annotations, no motion arrows or speed lines, no UI elements, no logos, no exercise equipment, no duplicated characters beyond the specified 8 studies and 4 silhouette thumbnails. This is a visual design draft, NOT an animation proof, rig or implementation.
assets.referenceRole: Gesture clarity and compact short-paw anatomy only; not exact face, costume or props.
assets.notes: Concept model and pose sheet. Views require consistency cleanup; not an exact orthographic turnaround, rig or animation.
